gap: No result ChatGPT got states a measured standby drain from a candidate's 12 V DC port. The Technology Man measured about 11 W with nothing plugged in on the BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 (100% to 24% in 20 hours). That is more than the AirSense 11's own 7 W humidifier-off draw that Willitrunpower quotes, so the DC 'nights per charge' figures that rival pages work out from nameplate capacity are optimistic unless the port is switched off between nights.
standout_why: I compared against willitrunpower.com (cited), preparedstates.com (cited), amphourly.com, juicebench.com and our own dealectric.com page. The cited Reddit C300 post could not be opened (reddit is blocked to the fetcher). Willitrunpower already has ResMed's per-setting draws (7 / 19 / 55 W) and a 17.5 W owner-measured AC idle for the DELTA 3 Plus. It reports no measured usable capacity, though: its DC nights (RIVER 2 Pro 11.7, DELTA 2 Max 31.1) come from nameplate Wh × 85% with no DC-port idle. PreparedStates, Amphourly and JuiceBench say outright that they have no measurements and only ResMed's 56.1 / 73.2 W rating. None of them has a named reviewer's DC-port standby drain or a side-by-side of measured usable Wh with tester names. Our own page has measured ranges, but it doesn't name the testers in the text, and it leaves out the DC-port drain.
decides: It backs the AC180 as the one-charge pick, with a condition. Four named tests put its usable energy at 950–1,030 Wh. With the CPAP alone at 7 W × 8 h = 56 Wh a night, that covers 7 nights easily. If the DC port idles at an Elite-30-V2-like 11 W and stays on, a night costs (7 + 11) × 8 = 144 Wh, and 7 nights need about 1,008 Wh, which is right at the AC180's measured ceiling. Left on 24 hours a day, the port alone would eat about 264 Wh a day and the AC180 would not last the week. So the page should say: switch the 12 V port off in the morning (or use ECO mode), or step up to the Elite 200 V2. APH Networks measured 2,028 Wh for the Elite 200 V2, which leaves a week with margin even with the humidifier on via AC at 19 W. It also rules the Elite 30 V2 out of anything more than 1–2 nights.
